summary: The paper presents an exceptional, machine-checked exact rational study of the three-dimensional normal cone of extremal quantum behaviors in Q2222. By introducing a dense rational parameterization, the author establishes exact rational coordinates for extreme points and normal-cone bases, proves an octagon-to-hexagon phase transition governed by the Tribonacci constant, demonstrates S4-subspace collapse versus Level-(1+AB) inflation, and establishes an unconditional four-tier NPA hierarchy separation. All 20 foundational theorems are formally verified in Lean 4 with zero sorry, supported by 13 standalone exact-Q certificates and an extensive adversarial test suite.
weaknesses: Dense mathematical notation and specialized quantum information formalism may require deep domain expertise to fully parse without sidecar code.
